inputs.name: hand over from Data Versioning to Training Data Drift Check

output.level_0: The versioned dataset pointer is corrupt, so the drift check crashes before it reads any store data.
output.level_1: No check compares the versioned training snapshot against recent till scans, so drift goes unnoticed.
output.level_2: A data engineer manually diffs the versioned training set against last week's sales to spot changes.
output.level_3: The pipeline automatically flags versioned datasets whose distribution has shifted beyond a set threshold.
output.level_4: Governed drift checks block training on stale versions and log every approval for audit trails.
